pyramiding_rule: Prohibit adding to positions unless floating profit on the base tranche exceeds 2x the current ATR and local volatility expansion is confirmed.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require minimum 3-bar order flow momentum alignment and spread filter below 35% of ATR prior to order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$10.00 profit and trail remainder using a 5-period EMA envelope to force runs toward +$20.00 to +$30.00.
